question: What engineering plans and clearances are mandatory when applying for a Demolition Permit from OCBO?
answer:
To apply for a Demolition Permit from the Office of the City Building Official (OCBO), the following engineering plans and clearances are mandatory:

1. Civil/Architectural Plans of the building or structure to be demolished (as per [S1] and [S2]).

Additionally, the following documents are also required:

1. Order of Payment (OP) and Official Receipt (OR) (as per [S1]).

For more information, please refer to the Citizens' Charter 2026, specifically the OCBD pages from Volume I & II-2, printed pages 553 and 558, chunks DEV120-OCBO-PDF0065-C001 and DEV120-OCBO-PDF0070-C001 to DEV120-OCBO-PDF0070-C002.

ground_truth: A Demolition Permit requires a demolition form, 3 sets of civil/architectural plans signed and sealed by a civil engineer/architect, vicinity sketch plan by a geodetic engineer, bill of materials, owner ID, and DPWH clearance if along a national highway.
